name: Myanmar
value: Civil war; no major city changed hands
summary: Civil war grinds on; junta relies on air strikes after failed Rakhine offensive
state: Fighting continued in Arakan, Sagaing, Shan and Chin in late October: the Arakan Army reported sinking two junta vessels near Sittwe on 26 Oct, and resistance media reported a junta air strike on Sittwe that killed 11 civilians on 23 Oct (unverified). No major city has changed hands this month.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice; much of Myanmar is unsafe for travel.
why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
